correctness.rationale: Checked RESULT.md's binomially normalized orthonormal basis and degree transfer: T_k=(omega_k/omega_{k+1})(a_1+a_2)/sqrt(k+1). A unitary Hadamard rotation sends the sum of bosonic annihilators to sqrt2 a_u while transverse v-degree r is conserved; iterating yields diagonal coefficients sqrt2^n omega_q/omega_{q+n} sqrt(q!/(q+n)!) sqrt((n+s)!/s!). Orthogonal output modes s=0..q exhaust all q+1 nonzero singular values of the surjective (q+1)x(q+n+1) transfer. These are strictly increasing in s, establishing endpoints and levelwise operator norms. All omega nonzero, phases may be gauged; bounded extension iff level norms uniformly bounded. Independent finite SVD checks for q,n=(0,3),(1,1),(2,3),(4,2),(6,4) agreed at numerical precision, but the Fock derivation handles unbounded degrees analytically.
